quote: It's amazing how people will give when you don't ask. Many of them send money because they believe in the message.
author: Joel Osteen

quote: Money and corruption are ruining the land, crooked politicians betray the working man, pocketing the profits and treating us like sheep, and we're tired of hearing promises that we know they'll never keep.
author: Ray Davies

quote: The price we have to pay for money is sometimes liberty.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quote: We can be thankful to a friend for a few acres, or a little money and yet for the freedom and command of the whole earth, and for the great benefits of our being, our life, health, and reason, we look upon ourselves as under no obligation.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

quote: Making money is art and working is art and good business is the best art.
author: Andy Warhol

quote: The chief value of money lies in the fact that one lives in a world in which it is overestimated.
author: H. L. Mencken

quote: I've seen the ticket, and I still can't believe it. When I see the money, I hope I don't hit the floor.
author: Judy Garland

quote: What have I got? No looks, no money, no education. Just talent.
author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quote: Money is human happiness in the abstract he, then, who is no longer capable of enjoying human happiness in the concrete devotes himself utterly to money.
author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quote: If our soldiers are not overburdened with money, it is not because they have a distaste for riches if their lives are not unduly long, it is not because they are disinclined to longevity.
author: Sun Tzu

quote: I went to the bank and asked to borrow a cup of money. They said, 'What for?' I said, 'I'm going to buy some sugar.'
author: Steven Wright

quote: As one digs deeper into the national character of the Americans, one sees that they have sought the value of everything in this world only in the answer to this single question: how much money will it bring in?
author: Alexis de Tocqueville

quote: I can inspire people on how to use money, how to get economically powerful.
author: Mike Tyson

quote: A real gentleman, even if he loses everything he owns, must show no emotion. Money must be so far beneath a gentleman that it is hardly worth troubling about.
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky

quote: I don't think the money people in Hollywood have ever thought I was normal, but I am dedicated to my work and that's what counts.
author: Angelina Jolie

quote: If all the rich and all of the church people should send their children to the public schools they would feel bound to concentrate their money on improving these schools until they met the highest ideals.
author: Susan B. Anthony

quote: Well private money can take risks in a way that government money often isn't willing to.
author: Bill Gates

quote: I did my time for the rape. I paid my money to Las Vegas. I paid my dues.
author: Mike Tyson

quote: I know why they don't like me because they want the money I have.
author: Mike Tyson

quote: Our money is bait money, and bait money is not to be used.
author: Mike Tyson

quote: There was one thing my daddy wouldn't tolerate in any shape, form or fashion, and that was being unkind or rude to somebody. That was just very important to my folks. And as it turns out, that was a legacy that he left me that money can't buy, is how to be able to treat people.
author: Paula Deen

quote: Motherhood is a great honor and privilege, yet it is also synonymous with servanthood. Every day women are called upon to selflessly meet the needs of their families. Whether they are awake at night nursing a baby, spending their time and money on less-than-grateful teenagers, or preparing meals, moms continuously put others before themselves.
author: Charles Stanley

quote: Labour was the first price, the original purchase - money that was paid for all things. It was not by gold or by silver, but by labour, that all wealth of the world was originally purchased.
author: Adam Smith

quote: Gambling with cards or dice or stocks is all one thing. It's getting money without giving an equivalent for it.
author: Henry Ward Beecher

quote: One might think that the money value of an invention constitutes its reward to the man who loves his work. But... I continue to find my greatest pleasure, and so my reward, in the work that precedes what the world calls success.
author: Thomas A. Edison

quote: I went into the business for the money, and the art grew out of it. If people are disillusioned by that remark, I can't help it. It's the truth.
author: Charlie Chaplin

quote: The writer must earn money in order to be able to live and to write, but he must by no means live and write for the purpose of making money.
author: Karl Marx

quote: Why is there so much month left at the end of the money?
author: John Barrymore

quote: I'd have stopped writing years ago if it were for the money.
author: Paulo Coelho

quote: There is no class so pitiably wretched as that which possesses money and nothing else.
author: Andrew Carnegie

quote: You are your greatest asset. Put your time, effort and money into training, grooming, and encouraging your greatest asset.
author: Tom Hopkins

quote: The problem with socialism is that you eventually run out of other peoples' money.
author: Margaret Thatcher

quote: Capital is money, capital is commodities. By virtue of it being value, it has acquired the occult ability to add value to itself. It brings forth living offspring, or, at the least, lays golden eggs.
author: Karl Marx

quote: I think one of the most pervasive evils in this world is greed and acquiring money for money's sake. Once you have six houses and a plane, it's just about a number. It's never been anything I understood.
author: Kevin Bacon

quote: Money can buy you a fine dog, but only love can make him wag his tail.
author: Kinky Friedman

quote: Economy does not lie in sparing money, but in spending it wisely.
author: Thomas Huxley

quote: When I graduated from high school, it was during the Depression and we had no money.
author: Ray Bradbury

quote: The big difference between sex for money and sex for free is that sex for money usually costs a lot less.
author: Brendan Behan

quote: There's so little money in my bank account, my scenic checks show a ghetto.
author: Phyllis Diller

quote: I spent a lot of money on booze, birds and fast cars. The rest I just squandered.
author: George Best

quote: There is a gigantic difference between earning a great deal of money and being rich.
author: Marlene Dietrich

quote: America believes in education: the average professor earns more money in a year than a professional athlete earns in a whole week.
author: Evan Esar

quote: A woman must have money and a room of her own if she is to write fiction.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: If a nation values anything more than freedom, it will lose its freedom, and the irony of it is that if it is comfort or money that it values more, it will lose that too.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: You don't appreciate a lot of stuff in school until you get older. Little things like being spanked every day by a middle-aged woman: Stuff you pay good money for in later life.
author: Emo Philips

quote: I have a problem with too much money. I can't reinvest it fast enough, and because I reinvest it, more money comes in. Yes, the rich do get richer.
author: Robert Kiyosaki

quote: Flattery is a kind of bad money, to which our vanity gives us currency.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

quote: I do not suppose I shall be remembered for anything. But I don't think about my work in those terms. It is just as vulgar to work for the sake of posterity as to work for the sake of money.
author: Orson Welles

quote: People who identify themselves as conservatives donate money to charity more often than people who identify themselves as liberals. They donate more money and a higher percentage of their incomes.
author: Thomas Sowell

quote: The sinews of war are infinite money.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quote: Money is like manure, of very little use except it be spread.
author: Francis Bacon

quote: Success is having to worry about every damn thing in the world, except money.
author: Johnny Cash

quote: I have ways of making money that you know nothing of.
author: John D. Rockefeller

quote: Because people have no thoughts to deal in, they deal cards, and try and win one another's money. Idiots!
author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quote: Getting money is not all a man's business: to cultivate kindness is a valuable part of the business of life.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: Property may be destroyed and money may lose its purchasing power but, character, health, knowledge and good judgement will always be in demand under all conditions.
author: Roger Babson

quote: Criminals are never very amusing. It's because they're failures. Those who make real money aren't counted as criminals. This is a class distinction, not an ethical problem.
author: Orson Welles

quote: The man who has no money is poor, but one who has nothing but money is poorer. He only is rich who can enjoy without owning he is poor who though he has millions is covetous.
author: Orison Swett Marden

quote: I never heard of an old man forgetting where he had buried his money! Old people remember what interests them: the dates fixed for their lawsuits, and the names of their debtors and creditors.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quote: The civility which money will purchase, is rarely extended to those who have none.
author: Charles Dickens

quote: A fascist is one whose lust for money or power is combined with such an intensity of intolerance toward those of other races, parties, classes, religions, cultures, regions or nations as to make him ruthless in his use of deceit or violence to attain his ends.
author: Henry A. Wallace

quote: Architect. One who drafts a plan of your house, and plans a draft of your money.
author: Ambrose Bierce

quote: If you don't want to work you have to work to earn enough money so that you won't have to work.
author: Ogden Nash

quote: Writing is like prostitution. First you do it for love, and then for a few close friends, and then for money.
author: Moliere

quote: I'd asked around 10 or 15 people for suggestions. Finally one lady friend asked the right question, 'Well, what do you love most?' That's how I started painting money.
author: Andy Warhol

quote: That's the trouble with being me. At this point, nobody gives a damn what my problem is. I could literally have a tumor on the side of my head and they'd be like, 'Yeah, big deal. I'd eat a tumor every morning for the kinda money you're pulling down.'
author: Jim Carrey

quote: Nothing is so strongly fortified that it cannot be taken by money.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

quote: The shortest period of time lies between the minute you put some money away for a rainy day and the unexpected arrival of rain.
author: Jane Bryant Quinn

quote: Right now it's only a notion, but I think I can get the money to make it into a concept, and later turn it into an idea.
author: Woody Allen

quote: I think writing really helps you heal yourself. I think if you write long enough, you will be a healthy person. That is, if you write what you need to write, as opposed to what will make money, or what will make fame.
author: Alice Walker

quote: When I get a little money I buy books and if any is left I buy food and clothes.
author: Desiderius Erasmus

quote: To be clever enough to get all that money, one must be stupid enough to want it.
author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quote: A drunkard would not give money to sober people. He said they would only eat it, and buy clothes and send their children to school with it.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: You can't get rid of poverty by giving people money.
author: P. J. O'Rourke

quote: Want of money and the distress of a thief can never be alleged as the cause of his thieving, for many honest people endure greater hardships with fortitude. We must therefore seek the cause elsewhere than in want of money, for that is the miser's passion, not the thief s.
author: William Blake

quote: To the eyes of a miser a guinea is more beautiful than the sun, and a bag worn with the use of money has more beautiful proportions than a vine filled with grapes.
author: William Blake

quote: Money is kind of a base subject. Like water, food, air and housing, it affects everything yet for some reason the world of academics thinks it's a subject below their social standing.
author: Robert Kiyosaki

quote: Success isn't measured by money or power or social rank. Success is measured by your discipline and inner peace.
author: Mike Ditka

quote: No man but a blockhead ever wrote except for money.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: A liberal is a man who is willing to spend somebody else's money.
author: Carter Glass

quote: The worst thing that can happen to a man is to lose his money, the next worst his health, the next worst his reputation.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: Money is the worst currency that ever grew among mankind. This sacks cities, this drives men from their homes, this teaches and corrupts the worthiest minds to turn base deeds.
author: Sophocles

quote: Admittedly, a homosexual can be conditioned to react sexually to a woman, or to an old boot for that matter. In fact, both homo - and heterosexual experimental subjects have been conditioned to react sexually to an old boot, and you can save a lot of money that way.
author: William S. Burroughs

quote: The first time you marry for love, the second for money, and the third for companionship.
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: False riches, consisting of money, houses and lands, acquired by selfish means at cost to others and thereafter used selfishly, are almost always used for the oppression of other persons.
author: Joseph Franklin Rutherford

quote: Liberals, it has been said, are generous with other peoples' money, except when it comes to questions of national survival when they prefer to be generous with other people's freedom and security.
author: William F. Buckley, Jr.

quote: It will be a great day when our schools have all the money they need, and our air force has to have a bake-sale to buy a bomber.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: People say that money is not the key to happiness, but I always figured if you have enough money, you can have a key made.
author: Joan Rivers

quote: I know it's going to be the private sector that leads this country out of the current economic times we're in. You can spend your money better than the government can spend your money.
author: George W. Bush

quote: Prices are important not because money is considered paramount but because prices are a fast and effective conveyor of information through a vast society in which fragmented knowledge must be coordinated.
author: Thomas Sowell

quote: The blues is losing someone you love and not having enough money to immerse yourself in drink.
author: Henry Rollins

quote: The safe way to double your money is to fold it over once and put it in your pocket.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: I hope all of you are going to fill out your census form when it comes in the mail next month. If you don't return the form the area you live in might get less government money and you wouldn't want that to happen, would you.
author: Andy Rooney

quote: In marriage do thou be wise: prefer the person before money, virtue before beauty, the mind before the body then thou hast a wife, a friend, a companion, a second self.
author: William Penn

quote: I think, in a way, I invented the term 'fight club' and that these things have always existed, but they never really had a label. Nobody had a language to apply to them. I created that language in two words and I've been paid a great deal of money for inventing two words and labeling something that has always been around.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: Money, it turned out, was exactly like sex, you thought of nothing else if you didn't have it and thought of other things if you did.
author: James A. Baldwin

quote: Boxing is the only sport you can get your brain shook, your money took and your name in the undertaker book.
author: Joe Frazier

quote: I have a lot of money.
author: Chuck Palahniuk

quote: He who receives money in trust to administer for the benefit of its owner, and uses it either for his own interest or against the wishes of its rightful owner, is a thief.
author: Jose Marti

quote: Brigands demand your money or your life women require both.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: To fulfill a dream, to be allowed to sweat over lonely labor, to be given a chance to create, is the meat and potatoes of life. The money is the gravy.
author: Bette Davis

quote: There are a handful of people whom money won't spoil, and we all count ourselves among them.
author: Mignon McLaughlin

quote: The darkest hour in any man's life is when he sits down to plan how to get money without earning it.
author: Horace Greeley

quote: We can safely abandon the doctrine of the eighties, namely that the rich were not working because they had too little money, the poor because they had much.
author: John Kenneth Galbraith

quote: Our greatest lack is not money for any undertaking, but rather ideas, If the ideas are good, cash will somehow flow to where it is needed.
author: Robert H. Schuller

quote: You never suffer from a money problem, you always suffer from an idea problem.
author: Robert H. Schuller

quote: Money can't buy you happiness but it does bring you a more pleasant form of misery.
author: Spike Milligan

quote: I refuse to feel guilty. I feel guilty about too much in my life but not about money. I went through periods when I had nothing, so somebody in my family has to get stinkin' wealthy.
author: Jim Carrey

quote: I have grown up alone. I've taken care of myself. I worked, earned money and was independent at 18.
author: Ingrid Bergman

quote: You cannot spend money in luxury without doing good to the poor. Nay, you do more good to them by spending it in luxury, than by giving it for by spending it in luxury, you make them exert industry, whereas by giving it, you keep them idle.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: Money and time are the heaviest burdens of life, and... the unhappiest of all mortals are those who have more of either than they know how to use.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: Money is the last enemy that shall never be subdued. While there is flesh there is money or the want of money, but money is always on the brain so long as there is a brain in reasonable order.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: Whoever said money can't buy happiness simply didn't know where to go shopping.
author: Bo Derek

quote: I call crony capitalism, where you take money from successful small businesses, spend it in Washington on favored industries, on favored individuals, picking winners and losers in the economy, that's not pro-growth economics. That's not entrepreneurial economics. That's not helping small businesses. That's cronyism, that's corporate welfare.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: When you first get money, you buy all these things so no one thinks you're mean, and you spread it around. You get a chauffeur and you find yourself thrown around the back of this car and you think, I was happier when I had my own little car! I could drive myself!
author: Paul McCartney

quote: I haven't been as wild with my money as somebody like me might have been. I've been very safe, very conservative with investments. I don't blow money. I don't have a ton of houses. I know things can go away. I've already had that experience.
author: Jim Carrey

quote: A drinker has a hole under his nose that all his money runs into.
author: Thomas Fuller

quote: You loan your friend money. You see them again, they don't say nothin' 'bout the money. 'Hi, how ya doin'? How's ya mama doing?' Man, how's my money doin'?
author: Chris Tucker

quote: If you real desire is to be good, there is no need to wait for the money before you do it you can do it now, this very moment, and just where you are.
author: James Allen

quote: The money can be a hindrance to someone like me because the danger is that you start thinking, 'Is that a $20 million take?' That kind of thing, and being self-critical.
author: Jim Carrey

quote: Money is a handmaiden, if thou knowest how to use it a mistress, if thou knowest not.
author: Horace

quote: The way to make money is to buy when blood is running in the streets.
author: John D. Rockefeller

quote: There are two things people want more than sex and money... recognition and praise.
author: Mary Kay Ash

quote: Teamwork is so important that it is virtually impossible for you to reach the heights of your capabilities or make the money that you want without becoming very good at it.
author: Brian Tracy

quote: Money is the string with which a sardonic destiny directs the motions of its puppets.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: Money is power, and in that government which pays all the public officers of the states will all political power be substantially concentrated.
author: Andrew Jackson

quote: The three most important things a man has are, briefly, his private parts, his money, and his religious opinions.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: It has been said that the love of money is the root of all evil. The want of money is so quite as truly.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: The want of money is the root of all evil.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: We shall never get people whose time is money to take much interest in atoms.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: The sinews of art and literature, like those of war, are money.
author: Samuel Butler

quote: After you're older, two things are possibly more important than any others: health and money.
author: Helen Gurley Brown

quote: I don't believe the most successful people are the ones who got the best grades, got into the best schools, or made the most money.
author: Ben Stein

quote: For a successful entrepreneur it can mean extreme wealth. But with extreme wealth comes extreme responsibility. And the responsibility for me is to invest in creating new businesses, create jobs, employ people, and to put money aside to tackle issues where we can make a difference.
author: Richard Branson

quote: Business, you know, may bring you money, but friendship hardly ever does.
author: Jane Austen

quote: I believe that sex is one of the most beautiful, natural, wholesome things that money can buy.
author: Steve Martin

quote: Even with my divorce and with everything, I don't need money.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: I have not been that wise. Health I have taken for granted. Love I have demanded, perhaps too much and too often. As for money, I have only realized its true worth when I didn't have it.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: No money is better spent than what is laid out for domestic satisfaction.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: There are few ways in which a man can be more innocently employed than in getting money.
author: Samuel Johnson

quote: We need to shift from an economic organizing principle for human civilization, to a humanitarian organizing principle. Making money more important than your own children is a pathological way for an individual to run their affairs, and it's a pathological way for a society to run its affairs.
author: Marianne Williamson

quote: If you work just for money, you'll never make it, but if you love what you're doing and you always put the customer first, success will be yours.
author: Ray Kroc

quote: I advise everybody not to save: spend your money. Most people save all their lives and leave it to somebody else. Money is to be enjoyed.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: I'd like to be rich. I'd like a lot of money to put into my physicals and to buy food for all my friends.
author: Syd Barrett

quote: Well, I think that California has had a history of always spending more money than it takes in.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: I have plenty of money, unlike other Hollywood celebrities or athletes that have not invested well.
author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quote: The focus on my appearance has really surprised me. I've always been a size 14 to 16, I don't care about clothes, I'd rather spend my money on cigarettes and booze.
author: Adele

quote: The more money an American accumulates, the less interesting he becomes.
author: Gore Vidal

quote: It isn't enough for you to love money - it's also necessary that money should love you.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: Who gets the risks? The risks are given to the consumer, the unsuspecting consumer and the poor work force. And who gets the benefits? The benefits are only for the corporations, for the money makers.
author: Cesar Chavez

quote: One must beware of ministers who can do nothing without money, and those who want to do everything with money.
author: Indira Gandhi

quote: Spirituality does two things for you. One, you are forced to become more selfless, two, you trust to providence. The opposite of a spiritual man is a materialist. If I was a materialist I would be making lots of money doing endorsements, doing cricket commentary. I have no interest in that.
author: Imran Khan

quote: When a fellow says, 'It ain't the money but the principle of the thing,' it's the money.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: Bargain... anything a customer thinks a store is losing money on.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: Nobody works as hard for his money as the man who marries it.
author: Kin Hubbard

quote: Money is like a sixth sense without which you cannot make a complete use of the other five.
author: W. Somerset Maugham

quote: Be the business never so painful, you may have it done for money.
author: Thomas Fuller

quote: The process by which banks create money is so simple that the mind is repelled.
author: John Kenneth Galbraith

quote: Money may not buy happiness, but it can damn well give it!
author: Freddie Mercury

quote: It costs a lot of money to look this cheap.
author: Dolly Parton

quote: Recommend virtue to your children it alone, not money, can make them happy. I speak from experience.
author: Ludwig van Beethoven

quote: Money, like vodka, turns a person into an eccentric.
author: Anton Chekhov

quote: One of the evils of money is that it tempts us to look at it rather than at the things that it buys.
author: E. M. Forster

quote: The political system is not for the people. The people are secondary to the economy. It's about what generates money, not about what benefits the people.
author: Ziggy Marley

quote: Knowledge is like money: to be of value it must circulate, and in circulating it can increase in quantity and, hopefully, in value.
author: Louis L'Amour

quote: People first, then money, then things.
author: Suze Orman

quote: Bank failures are caused by depositors who don't deposit enough money to cover losses due to mismanagement.
author: Dan Quayle

quote: Sure, I have friends, plenty of friends, and they all come around wantin' to borrow money. I've always been generous with my friends and family, with money, but selfish with the important stuff like love.
author: Richard Pryor

quote: In fact, the confidence of the people is worth more than money.
author: Carter G. Woodson

quote: If money titles meant anything, I'd play more tournaments. The only thing that means a lot to me is winning. If I have more wins than anybody else and win more majors than anybody else in the same year, then it's been a good year.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: When an actor has money he doesn't send letters, he sends telegrams.
author: Anton Chekhov

quote: Money can't buy you happiness, but it can buy you a yacht big enough to pull up right alongside it.
author: David Lee Roth

quote: The day, water, sun, moon, night - I do not have to purchase these things with money.
author: Plautus

quote: Like anything else that happens on its own, the act of writing is beyond currency. Money is great stuff to have, but when it comes to the act of creation, the best thing is not to think of money too much. It constipates the whole process.
author: Stephen King

quote: Nothing induces me to read a novel except when I have to make money by writing about it. I detest them.
author: Virginia Woolf

quote: Certainly there are things in life that money can't buy, but it's very funny - Did you ever try buying then without money?
author: Ogden Nash

quote: If borrowing and spending all this money led to more jobs than we would be at full employment already.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: Sincerity: willingness to spend one's own money.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: Kindness eases everything almost as much as money does.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: An athlete cannot run with money in his pockets. He must run with hope in his heart and dreams in his head.
author: Emil Zatopek

quote: Books are the money of Literature, but only the counters of Science.
author: Thomas Huxley

quote: The greatest pleasure when I started making money was not buying cars or yachts but finding myself able to have as many freshly typed drafts as possible.
author: Gore Vidal

quote: Politics isn't about big money or power games it's about the improvement of people's lives.
author: Paul Wellstone

quote: If you dream of something worth doing and then simply go to work on it and don't think anything of personalities, or emotional conflicts, or of money, or of family distractions it is amazing how quickly you get through those 5,000 steps.
author: Edwin Land

quote: He who controls the money supply of a nation controls the nation.
author: James A. Garfield

quote: I'm hopeless with money I simply spend what I've got.
author: Freddie Mercury

quote: Well, I think indigenous peoples have ways of living on the Earth that they've had forever. And they've been overrun by organized religion, which has had a lot of money and power.
author: Alice Walker

quote: My goal isn't to make money, it's to try and survive and make a point.
author: Marilyn Manson

quote: I'm not a driven businessman, but a driven artist. I never think about money. Beautiful things make money.
author: Lord Acton

quote: Find something in life that you love doing. If you make a lot of money, that's a bonus, and if you don't, you still won't hate going to work.
author: Jeff Foxworthy

quote: But men are so full of greed today, they'll sell anything for a little piece of money.
author: Little Richard

quote: Almost anyone can be an author the business is to collect money and fame from this state of being.
author: A. A. Milne

quote: The trouble with our people is as soon as they got out of slavery they didn't want to give the white man nothing else. But the fact is, you got to give em something. Either your money, your land, your woman or your ass.
author: Alice Walker

quote: Money and women. They're two of the strongest things in the world. The things you do for a woman you wouldn't do for anything else. Same with money.
author: Satchel Paige

quote: The man whose only pleasure in life is making money, weighs less on the moral scale than an angleworm.
author: Josh Billings

quote: I don't understand it. Jack will spend any amount of money to buy votes but he balks at investing a thousand dollars in a beautiful painting.
author: Jackie Kennedy

quote: Why should people go out and pay money to see bad films when they can stay at home and see bad television for nothing?
author: Samuel Goldwyn

quote: I think that in a year I may retire. I cannot take my money with me when I die and I wish to enjoy it, with my family, while I live. I should prefer living in Germany to any other country, though I am an American, and am loyal to my country.
author: Harry Houdini

quote: You know, I look like a woman but I think like a man. And in this world of business, that has helped me a lot. Because by the time they think that I don't know what's goin' on, I then got the money, and gone.
author: Dolly Parton

quote: Language is like money, without which specific relative values may well exist and be felt, but cannot be reduced to a common denominator.
author: George Santayana

quote: The thing that differentiates man from animals is money.
author: Gertrude Stein

quote: People have taken time out of their day and spent their money to come sit down at a concert. And it's jazz music-it's not easy for them to get to it. I don't want them ever to feel that I'm taking their presence lightly.
author: Wynton Marsalis

quote: I'm not really interested in making money.
author: Steven Spielberg

quote: Money is to my social existence what health is to my body.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: I really don't like talking about money. All I can say is that the Good Lord must have wanted me to have it.
author: Larry Bird

quote: Where large sums of money are concerned, it is advisable to trust nobody.
author: Agatha Christie

quote: We need your help. I need your help. We need money for research. It may not save my life. It may save my children's life. It may save someone you love. And it's very important.
author: Jim Valvano

quote: The strongest bank in the United States will last only so long as the people will have sufficient confidence in it to keep their money there.
author: Carter G. Woodson

quote: But human nature dictates that there will always be cheaters. That's inevitable. Where there's money involved and glory, there are going to be people that cheat, and there will always be ways to cheat.
author: David Millar

quote: I would prefer to have no money but to have a nice family and good friends around.
author: Li Na

quote: New York City is a great monument to the power of money and greed... a race for rent.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright

quote: The passion for money is never fickle.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: To understand someone, find out how he spends his money.
author: Mason Cooley

quote: Poverty is multidimensional. It extends beyond money incomes to education, health care, political participation and advancement of one's own culture and social organisation.
author: Atal Bihari Vajpayee

quote: If you can actually count your money, then you're not a rich man.
author: J. Paul Getty

quote: What we really want to do is what we are really meant to do. When we do what we are meant to do, money comes to us, doors open for us, we feel useful, and the work we do feels like play to us.
author: Julia Cameron

quote: I'm proud to pay taxes in the United States the only thing is, I could be just as proud for half the money.
author: Arthur Godfrey

quote: Those whose life is long still strive for gain, and for all mortals all things take second place to money.
author: Sophocles

quote: I don't talk about money.
author: Kim Kardashian

quote: I've always thought anyone can make money. Making a life worth living, that's the real test.
author: Robert Fulghum

quote: It's very important that every movie I do makes money because I want the people that had the faith in me to get their money back.
author: Quentin Tarantino

quote: Time is like money, the less we have of it to spare the further we make it go.
author: Josh Billings

quote: I've had an exciting time I married for love and got a little money along with it.
author: Rose Kennedy

quote: George wrote Taxman, and I played guitar on it. He wrote it in anger at finding out what the taxman did. He had never known before then what could happen to your money.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: All money is a matter of belief.
author: Adam Smith

quote: I'm looking for backing for an unauthorized auto-biography that I am writing. Hopefully, this will sell in such huge numbers that I will be able to sue myself for an extraordinary amount of money and finance the film version in which I will play everybody.
author: David Bowie

quote: A man who cannot be enticed by money or intimidated by the threat of jail or death has two of the strongest weapons that anyone has to offer.
author: Jesse Jackson

quote: Taxation is just a sophisticated way of demanding money with menaces.
author: Terry Pratchett

quote: A wise person should have money in their head, but not in their heart.
author: Jonathan Swift

quote: If you are worried about job security and do not have an adequate emergency fund (ideally eight months' worth of living expenses stashed away in a federally insured bank or credit union), you need to focus more on saving money than paying down the balance on your credit cards.
author: Suze Orman

quote: No, not rich. I am a poor man with money, which is not the same thing.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez

quote: What's the use of happiness? It can't buy you money.
author: Henny Youngman

quote: If one man in the country could take all the money, what was the use of passing any bills about it?
author: Davy Crockett

quote: You lose your individuality a huge amount when you have no money, and I certainly had that experience.
author: J. K. Rowling

quote: I know of nothing more despicable and pathetic than a man who devotes all the hours of the waking day to the making of money for money's sake.
author: John D. Rockefeller

quote: Neither soldiers nor money can defend a king but only friends won by good deeds, merit, and honesty.
author: Sallust

quote: As long as you have a system that is based on the rational that if you are making money you are thereby making a contribution to society, these financial rogue practices will continue.
author: David Korten

quote: A majority, perhaps as many as 75 percent, of abortion clinics are in areas with high minority populations. Abortion apologists will say this is because they want to serve the poor. You don't serve the poor, however, by taking their money to terminate their children.
author: Alveda King

quote: If we think we have ours and don't owe any time or money or effort to help those left behind, then we are a part of the problem rather than the solution to the fraying social fabric that threatens all Americans.
author: Marian Wright Edelman

quote: Knowledge is like money: the more he gets, the more he craves.
author: Josh Billings

quote: I haven't got as much money as some folks, but I've got as much impudence as any of them, and that's the next thing to money.
author: Josh Billings

quote: It ain't often that a man's reputation outlasts his money.
author: Josh Billings

quote: Money will buy a pretty good dog, but it won't buy the wag of his tail.
author: Josh Billings

quote: Don't cling to fame. You're just borrowing it. It's like money. You're going to die, and somebody else is going to get it.
author: Sonny Bono

quote: You shouldn't have to have money to have a luxury fragrance.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: A group or an artist shouldn't get his money until his boss gets his.
author: Bobby Darin

quote: What money is better bestowed than that of a schoolboy's tip? How the kindness is recalled by the recipient in after days! It blesses him that gives and him that takes.
author: William Makepeace Thackeray

quote: Capitalism is using its money we socialists throw it away.
author: Fidel Castro

quote: Remember that government doesn't earn one single dollar it spends. In order for you to get money from the government, that money must first be taken from somebody else.
author: Jesse Ventura

quote: Opposites may attract, but I wouldn't put my money on a relationship of financial opposites.
author: Suze Orman

quote: I can't afford to die I'd lose too much money.
author: George Burns

quote: You can be young without money but you can't be old without it.
author: Tennessee Williams

quote: American men, as a group, seem to be interested in only two things, money and breasts. It seems a very narrow outlook.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: I'm fulfilled in what I do. I never thought that a lot of money or fine clothes - the finer things of life - would make you happy. My concept of happiness is to be filled in a spiritual sense.
author: Coretta Scott King

quote: It is a sad fact about our culture that a poet can earn much more money writing or talking about his art than he can by practicing it.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: I've always said money may buy you a fine dog, but only love can make it wag its tail.
author: Kinky Friedman

quote: A man must love a thing very much if he not only practices it without any hope of fame and money, but even... without any hope of doing it well.
author: Oliver Herford

quote: A moderate addiction to money may not always be hurtful but when taken in excess it is nearly always bad for the health.
author: Clarence Day

quote: Here's how I think of my money - as soldiers - I send them out to war everyday. I want them to take prisoners and come home, so there's more of them.
author: Kevin O'Leary

quote: I know why most people never get rich. They put the money ahead of the job. If you just think of the job, the money will automatically follow. This never fails.
author: Hedy Lamarr

quote: Why are people unemployed? Because there is no work. Why is there no work? Because people are not buying products and services. Why are people not buying products and services? Because they have no money. Why do people have no money? Because they are unemployed.
author: Craig Bruce

quote: I don't want to make money I want to make a difference.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Look, we know we screwed up when we were in the majority. We fell in love with power. We spent way too much money - especially on earmarks. There was too much corruption when we ran this place. We were guilty. And that's why we lost.
author: Eric Cantor

quote: To keep the record straight, it wasn't always John and Yoko. We've all accused one another of various business things we tend to be pretty paranoid by now, as you can imagine. There's a lot of money involved.
author: Paul McCartney

quote: People will always choose more money over more sex.
author: Doug Coupland

quote: Almost the only persons who may be said to comprehend even approximately the significance, principles, and purposes of Socialism are the chief leaders of the extreme wings of the Socialistic forces, and perhaps a few of the money kings themselves.
author: Benjamin Tucker

quote: Put not your trust in money, but put your money in trust.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes

quote: As they say around the Texas Legislature, if you can't drink their whiskey, screw their women, take their money, and vote against 'em anyway, you don't belong in office.
author: Molly Ivins

quote: Nowadays nothing but money counts: a fortune brings honors, friendships the poor man everywhere lies low.
author: Ovid

quote: Money is like manure. You have to spread it around or it smells.
author: J. Paul Getty

quote: Anyone who wants to sell you overnight success or wealth is not interested in your success they are interested in your money.
author: Bo Bennett

quote: Look, I'm very much in favor of tax cuts, but not with borrowed money. And the problem that we've gotten into in recent years is spending programs with borrowed money, tax cuts with borrowed money, and at the end of the day that proves disastrous. And my view is I don't think we can play subtle policy here.
author: Alan Greenspan

quote: Until we totally change the way we elect our leaders, until we remove private money from public campaigns, lying will be the de facto method of governance in this country.
author: Peter Schuyler

quote: But there are too many people that make so much money at the cost of lives of other humans and for no reason but to make the money.
author: Lily Tomlin

quote: Thinking in its lower grades, is comparable to paper money, and in its higher forms it is a kind of poetry.
author: Havelock Ellis

quote: Unfaithfulness in the keeping of an appointment is an act of clear dishonesty. You may as well borrow a person's money as his time.
author: Horace Mann

quote: There's no money in poetry, but then there's no poetry in money, either.
author: Robert Graves

quote: When I was waiting tables, washing dishes, or mowing lawns for money, I never thought of myself as stuck in some station in life. I was on my own path, my own journey, an American journey where I could think for myself, decide for myself, define happiness for myself.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: I decided to pursue music, so I dropped out of school and I told my parents I didn't want any money from them. I got three jobs and I just hit the ground running.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: A lot of people in the media, and some everyday people, really aren't in search of the truth. They're in search of something worse than that. Money, yeah. I think the media's the kind of a thing where the truth doesn't win, because it's no fun. The truth's no fun.
author: Jack White

quote: If someone decides to be a musician now, it means because there is no hope of money at the end of it, it means they really want to be a musician. And if someone is writing now, there is no hope for money at the end of it.
author: Doug Coupland

quote: I think money is due for some sort of collapse. People are going to realize that money has a half-life, like radioactive elements.
author: Doug Coupland

quote: I am not a pig farmer. The pigs had a great time, but I didn't make any money.
author: Willie Nelson

quote: If time is money, it seems moral to save time, above all one's own, and such parsimony is excused by consideration for others. One is straight-forward.
author: Theodor Adorno

quote: Congress, the press, and the bureaucracy too often focus on how much money or effort is spent, rather than whether the money or effort actually achieves the announced goal.
author: Donald Rumsfeld

quote: Presidential leadership needn't always cost money. Look for low- and no-cost options. They can be surprisingly effective.
author: Donald Rumsfeld

quote: All I wanted to do was write - at the time, poems, and prose, too. I guess my ambition was simply to make money however I could to keep myself going in some modest way, and I didn't need much, I was unmarried at the time, no children.
author: Paul Auster

quote: We at Chrysler borrow money the old-fashioned way. We pay it back.
author: Lee Iacocca

quote: No man's credit is as good as his money.
author: John Dewey

quote: Victory is everything. You can spend the money but you can never spend the memories.
author: Ken Venturi

quote: Of course, I do everything for money.
author: Christopher Hitchens

quote: It was Public Art, defined as art that is purchased by experts who are not spending their own personal money.
author: Dave Barry

quote: Money is the seed of money, and the first guinea is sometimes more difficult to acquire than the second million.
author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

quote: We do not have a money problem in America. We have a values and priorities problem.
author: Marian Wright Edelman

quote: What I've learned is that you really don't need to be a celebrity or have money or have the paparazzi following you around to be famous.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: Some artists are working to buy the mansion or whatever the element of fame must bear, but I spend all my money on my show.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: I don't care about money.
author: Lady Gaga

quote: The forties, seventies, and the nineties, when money was scarce, were great periods, when the art world retracted but it was also reborn.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Money is something that can be measured art is not. It's all subjective.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Art usually only makes the news in America when the subject is money.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Not to say people shouldn't get rich from art. I adore the alchemy wherein artists who cast a complex spell make rich people give them their money. (Just writing it makes me cackle.) But too many artists have been making money without magic.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: One argument goes that recessions are good for female artists because when money flies out the window, women are allowed in the house. The other claims that when money ebbs, so do prospects for women.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: In the seventies, a group of American artists seized the means not of production but of reproduction. They tore apart visual culture at a time of no money, no market, and no one paying attention except other artists. Vietnam and Watergate had happened everything in America was being questioned.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: The last time money left the art world, intrepid types maxed out their credit cards and opened galleries, and a few of them have become the best in the world.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Much good art got made while money ruled I like a lot of it, and hardship and poverty aren't virtues. The good news is that, since almost no one will be selling art, artists - especially emerging ones - won't have to think about turning out a consistent style or creating a brand. They'll be able to experiment as much as they want.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: When money and hype recede from the art world, one thing I won't miss will be what curator Francesco Bonami calls the 'Eventocracy.' All this flashy 'art-fair art' and those highly produced space-eating spectacles and installations wow you for a minute until you move on to the next adrenaline event.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: 'Untitled' is a time machine that can transport you to 1992, an edgy moment when the art world was crumbling, money was scarce, and artists like Tiravanija were in the nascent stages of combining Happenings, performance art, John Cage, Joseph Beuys, and the do-it-yourself ethos of punk. Meanwhile, a new art world was coming into being.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Now people look at 'The Scream' or Van Gogh's 'Irises' or a Picasso and see its new content: money. Auction houses inherently equate capital with value.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: Art is for anyone. It just isn't for everyone. Still, over the past decade, its audience has hugely grown, and that's irked those outside the art world, who get irritated at things like incomprehensibility or money.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: I love art dealers. In some ways, they're my favorite people in the art world. Really. I love that they put their money where their taste is, create their own aesthetic universes, support artists, employ people, and do all of this while letting us see art for free. Many are visionaries.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: When museums are built these days, architects, directors, and trustees seem most concerned about social space: places to have parties, eat dinner, wine-and-dine donors. Sure, these are important these days - museums have to bring in money - but they gobble up space and push the art itself far away from the entrance.
author: Jerry Saltz

quote: The people of this country, not special interest big money, should be the source of all political power.
author: Paul Wellstone

quote: Many people are in the dark when it comes to money, and I'm going to turn on the lights.
author: Suze Orman

quote: Take free money. No matter how in debt you are, if your employer offers a matching contribution on a 401(k) or other retirement vehicle, you must sign up and contribute enough to get the maximum company match each year. Think of it as a bonus.
author: Suze Orman

quote: Growing up in a particular neighborhood, growing up in a working-class family, not having much money, all of those things fire you and can give you an edge, can give you an anger.
author: Gary Oldman

quote: I think it would be cool if you were writing a ransom note on your computer, if the paper clip popped up and said, 'Looks like you're writing a ransom note. Need help? You should use more forceful language, you'll get more money.'
author: Demetri Martin

quote: My Vegas act is how I make my money.
author: Rita Rudner

quote: No woman marries for money they are all clever enough, before marrying a millionaire, to fall in love with him first.
author: Cesare Pavese

quote: But all the money in the world cannot make you happy either, so there has to be a balance.
author: Heidi Klum

quote: Making a movie requires 20 to 500 people to make and a lot of money and the stakes are a lot higher.
author: Alanis Morissette

quote: Music has always been my back door to life. It is important for people to find something that excites them. I like the concept that if you do what excites you, you will be rewarded generously, whatever form reward takes, which is not necessarily money.
author: Brandon Boyd

quote: I definitely spend the most money on shoes, partly because vintage footwear can be a little funky - in a bad way. I like to keep things pretty simple up top and then go weird with the shoes.
author: Chloe Sevigny

quote: If there is no hell, a good many preachers are obtaining money under false pretenses.
author: Billy Sunday

quote: In a very weak economy, when you say 'cut government spending,' what you mean is you're laying off school teachers and you're de-funding various programs that put money into the economy. This means you have more unemployed people that then draw unemployment benefits and don't pay taxes.
author: Fareed Zakaria

quote: We need to reclaim our American system of limited government, low taxes, reasonable regulations, and sound money, which has blessed us with unprecedented prosperity. And it has done more to help the poor than any other economic system ever designed.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: That's the real secret to job creation - not borrowing and spending more money in Washington.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: We need to stop spending money we don't have.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: What did the taxpayers get out of the Obama stimulus? More debt. That money wasn't just spent and wasted - it was borrowed, spent, and wasted.
author: Paul Ryan

quote: A runner must run with dreams in his heart, not money in his pocket.
author: Emil Zatopek

quote: I'm free of stress and worries now because if I don't like something I'm doing, I just find the fun in it instead of being miserable. Let me have fun with the people I work with, let me have fun making money - when I grew up so poor, ya know?
author: Jenny McCarthy

quote: This is our commitment to users and the people who use our service, is that Facebook's a free service. It's free now. It will always be free. We make money through having advertisements and things like that.
author: Mark Zuckerberg

quote: Is it not odd that the only generous person I ever knew, who had money to be generous with, should be a stockbroker.
author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quote: A development deal is where they're giving you recording time and money to record, but not promising that they'll put an album out.
author: Taylor Swift

quote: I'm tired of love I'm still more tired of rhyme but money gives me pleasure all the time.
author: Hilaire Belloc

quote: Money is the root of all evil, and yet it is such a useful root that we cannot get on without it any more than we can without potatoes.
author: Louisa May Alcott

quote: Wal-Mart doesn't really care about your faith. Wal-Mart cares if you have money to spend, and it is going to be as generic as possible in exploiting the holiday season for every buck it can make.
author: Richard Roeper

quote: Nowadays love is a matter of chance, matrimony a matter of money and divorce a matter of course.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: Life is a game. Money is how we keep score.
author: Ted Turner

quote: Jon Stewart is exactly the same guy he's always been, only with money. He knows that the moment he really believes he's important, the funny goes away and he becomes Bill O'Reilly, except shorter and Jewish.
author: Denis Leary

quote: And of course I didn't make any money from stand up for years, so I had temp jobs. That was the way I made money.
author: Demetri Martin

quote: They still have some money, and they have needs to supply. They must begin immediately to pool their earnings and organize industries to participate in supplying social and economic demands.
author: Carter G. Woodson

quote: There are two kinds of power you have to fight. The first is the money, and that's just our system. The other is the people close around you, knowing when to accept their criticism, knowing when to say no.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: Work isn't to make money you work to justify life.
author: Marc Chagall

quote: If we pollute the air, water and soil that keep us alive and well, and destroy the biodiversity that allows natural systems to function, no amount of money will save us.
author: David Suzuki

quote: I pity the French Cinema because it has no money. I pity the American Cinema because it has no ideas.
author: Jean-Luc Godard

quote: If you got the money honey I got the time and when you run out of money honey I run out of time.
author: Willie Nelson

quote: When you hire that first person, then you're a boss. You've got performance reviews. You've got complaints about not making enough money. You've got people who are just going to sell your story to the tabloids.
author: Scott Adams

quote: The only security men can have for their political liberty, consists in keeping their money in their own pockets.
author: Lysander Spooner

quote: It can be liberating to get fired because you realize the world doesn't end. There's other ways to make money, better jobs.
author: Ron Livingston

quote: Money couldn't buy friends, but you got a better class of enemy.
author: Spike Milligan

quote: I don't really care about money. I find money boring and accounting boring, so I'm probably not going to ever make a lot of money.
author: Juliana Hatfield

quote: The music business is motivated by money. Music is motivated by energy and feelings.
author: Erykah Badu

quote: The flood of money that gushes into politics today is a pollution of democracy.
author: Theodore White

quote: Spare no expense to save money on this one.
author: Samuel Goldwyn

quote: Here I am paying big money to you writers and what for? All you do is change the words.
author: Samuel Goldwyn

quote: The key to making money is to stay invested.
author: Suze Orman

quote: A fool and her money are soon courted.
author: Helen Rowland

quote: France is a place where the money falls apart in your hands but you can't tear the toilet paper.
author: Billy Wilder

quote: Great dad. Yeah, he would ask me for money on birthdays and, you know, inappropriate times. And I just wrote him off like, 'You're not a father.' I just learned you cannot emotionally invest in people who are not attainable.
author: Drew Barrymore

quote: Divorce is one of the most financially traumatic things you can go through. Money spent on getting mad or getting even is money wasted.
author: Richard Wagner

quote: And, we have no such thing as a budget anymore. Our manager freaks when we show him the bill. We're lavish to the bone, but all our money goes back into the product.
author: Freddie Mercury

quote: Labor was the first price, the original purchase - money that was paid for all things.
author: Adam Smith

quote: My other family is Fleetwood Mac. I don't need the money, but there's an emotional need for me to go on the road again. There's a love there we're a band of brothers.
author: Stevie Nicks

quote: Countries have lost their culture because what they wanted was money. Money became the running theme in every country and culture was sacrificed.
author: Yoko Ono

quote: My generation will actually be the first generation that is tamer than the one that came before it, and it will probably be poorer less fun and less money.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: Money and fame made me believe I was entitled. I was wrong and foolish.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: I felt that I had worked hard my entire life and deserved to enjoy all the temptations around me. I felt I was entitled, and thanks to money and fame, I didn't have to go far to find them.
author: Tiger Woods

quote: One thing that people keep on saying to me is that the wealth and the fame must have made up for missing out on my childhood. But the idea of money - putting a price on your childhood - is ridiculous. You will never get those years back and you can't put a price on them.
author: Tom Felton

quote: I bought a lot of rubbish things that kids buy: skateboards and clothes and typical teenage stuff. And, as soon as I could, I wasted a lot of money on cars - BMW's mostly - for myself and my family.
author: Tom Felton

quote: We are going as fast as we can as soon as we can. We're in a race against time, until we run out of money.
author: Jack Nicholson

quote: The only point in making money is, you can tell some big shot where to go.
author: Humphrey Bogart

quote: I am a liberated woman. And I do believe if a woman does equal work she should be paid equal money. But personally I am feminine and I do like male authority to lean on.
author: Julie Andrews

quote: I never left France for Hollywood nor stashed my money in Switzerland.
author: Brigitte Bardot

quote: As I have said for many years throughout this land, we're borrowing money from China to buy oil from the Persian Gulf to burn it in ways that destroy the future of human civilization. Every bit of that has to change.
author: Al Gore

quote: I had more clothes than I had closets, more cars than garage space, but no money.
author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quote: Money is such an amazing teacher: What you choose to do with your money shows whether you are truly powerful or powerless.
author: Suze Orman

quote: Having money is rather like being a blond. It is more fun but not vital.
author: Mary Quant

quote: People assume I'm out there having this great life, but money doesn't erase the pain. When you're young you barrel through life, making choices without thinking of repercussions. A few years down the line, you wake up in a certain place and wonder how the hell you got there.
author: Jennifer Lopez

quote: Money is in some respects life's fire: it is a very excellent servant, but a terrible master.
author: P. T. Barnum

quote: It's our money, and we're free to spend it any way we please.
author: Rose Kennedy

quote: I don't know what to do with it. I'm very fortunate to have it, and it gives you room to maneuver. But the main thing about having money is it means you don't have to worry about it. And that for me is a lovely thing. It's not for fast cars and hookers.
author: Daniel Radcliffe

quote: I don't work very much, and I just sit here waiting for a script that I can't refuse - and I'm not talking about money.
author: Michael Caine

quote: I decided I ought to pick a project that would not be controversial, that would not really cost the government a lot of money.
author: Barbara Bush

quote: I had some money, I made the best paintings ever. I was completely reclusive, worked a lot, took a lot of drugs. I was awful to people.
author: Jean-Michel Basquiat

quote: If you put all your strength and faith and vigor into a job and try to do the best you can, the money will come.
author: Lawrence Welk

quote: I've got my eye on a few things to spend my money on. I've got my own bank card but I am really good with money. I don't spend too much at all.
author: Justin Bieber

quote: You have to spend a lot to make a lot. It's not like I'm sitting on top of a pile of money.
author: Katy Perry

quote: As kids we didn't complain about being poor we talked about how rich we were going to be and made moves to get the lifestyle we aspired to by any means we could. And as soon as we had a little money, we were eager to show it.
author: Jay-Z

quote: While money doesn't buy love, it puts you in a great bargaining position.
author: Christopher Marlowe

quote: France is the country where the money falls apart and you can't tear the toilet paper.
author: Billy Wilder

quote: I think there's only one or two films where I've had all the financial support I needed. All the rest, I wish I'd had the money to shoot another ten days.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: Young film makers should learn how to deal with the money and learn how to deal with the power structure. Because it is like a battle.
author: Martin Scorsese

quote: I don't understand the whole dating thing. I know right off the bat if I'm interested in someone, and I don't want them to waste their money on me and take me out to eat if I know I'm not interested in that person.
author: Britney Spears

quote: My body can't put anyone in jeopardy of not making money anymore - my body is just not on the table that way anymore.
author: Christina Aguilera

quote: There is nothing in socialism that a little age or a little money will not cure.
author: Will Durant

quote: Starting out to make money is the greatest mistake in life. Do what you feel you have a flair for doing, and if you are good enough at it, the money will come.
author: Greer Garson

quote: I know a lot of celebrities who are perfectly happy to put their name to something and then leave it at that because the money is good, but I need to have complete control over how something is going to look if my name is going to be attached to it.
author: Heidi Klum

quote: To this day, I am the least materialistic person I know, because my father didn't raise me to just go out and buy this or that car. The only reason I wanted to make money as an actor was because I'm passionate about food!
author: Hugh Jackman

quote: They're very, uh, you know, I don't come from the suburbs and a jolly, Disney type of lifestyle. I come from something totally different. And they're cool and bare minimum so it's not always a money issue for me.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: I turned down twelve films last year... Huge money films, but I had no respect for the writer or the work.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: Arab leaders worry more about making money from the profits they get from oil and gas that they turn the other way when Lebanon is being destroyed right next to them. Their neighbours are being murdered, but they only make calculations for their own benefit.
author: Abu Bakar Bashir

quote: At this point I have enough money to live 25 lifetimes. You couldn't spend the money I've accrued now.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: My first car, I got it in an auction at my temple. It was an '86 Volvo that I got for 500 bucks, and then wound up throwing $10,000 into the stereo system and put TVs in the foot rests. It was the most ridiculous Volvo you'd ever seen, but I had never had money before and I was out of my mind.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: You can't have bank holding companies acting as hedge funds. You can't have them taking a million-dollar pension plan for Joe Schmo the bus driver and treat it with the same risk appetite that you treat George Soros' pocket money. It's fundamentally ridiculous.
author: Shia LaBeouf

quote: And you can't have a prosperous economy when the government is way overspending, raising tax rates, printing too much money, over regulating and restricting free trade. It just can't be done.
author: Arthur Laffer

quote: Everybody gets everything handed to them. The rich inherit it. I don't mean just inheritance of money. I mean what people take for granted among the middle and upper classes, which is nepotism, the old-boy network.
author: Toni Morrison

quote: Go miser go, for money sell your soul. Trade wares for wares and trudge from pole to pole, So others may say when you are dead and gone. See what a vast estate he left his son.
author: John Dryden

quote: It takes no compromising to give people their rights. It takes no money to respect the individual. It takes no survey to remove repressions.
author: Harvey Milk

quote: I have too much money invested in sweaters.
author: Bob Hope

quote: I like to sing ballads the way Eddie Fisher does and the way Perry Como does. But the way I'm singing now is what makes the money.
author: Elvis Presley

quote: Money is like hormones. It's just how you feel on any given day.
author: Janice Dickinson

quote: But without a caring society, without each citizen voluntarily accepting the weight of responsibility, government is destined to grow even larger, taking more of your money, burrowing deeper into your lives.
author: Jeb Bush

quote: Never work just for money or for power. They won't save your soul or help you sleep at night.
author: Marian Wright Edelman

quote: I have no idea how much money I've got.
author: Daniel Radcliffe

quote: People who have car collections - I never understood that. I always thought that was unnecessary. It's not beautiful, it's not creative. It's just showing how much money you've got.
author: Daniel Radcliffe

quote: A rich man told me recently that a liberal is a man who tells other people what to do with their money.
author: Amiri Baraka

quote: You're right on the money with that. We're all like detectives in life. There's something at the end of the trail that we're all looking for.
author: David Lynch

quote: Save your money. You're going to need twice as much money in your old age as you think.
author: Michael Caine

quote: I like my money right where I can see it... hanging in my closet.
author: Sarah Jessica Parker

quote: That is why the analogy of stealing does not work. With a thief, we want to know how much money he stole, and from whom. With the artist it is not how much he took and from whom, but what he did with it.
author: Lukas Foss

quote: The companies that survive longest are the one's that work out what they uniquely can give to the world not just growth or money but their excellence, their respect for others, or their ability to make people happy. Some call those things a soul.
author: Charles Handy

quote: A corporation's primary goal is to make money. Government's primary role is to take a big chunk of that money and give it to others.
author: Larry Ellison

quote: I've never really had a hobby, unless you count art, which the IRS once told me I had to declare as a hobby since I hadn't made money with it.
author: Laurie Anderson

quote: Money is just the poor man's credit card.
author: Marshall McLuhan

quote: Money is a poor man's credit card.
author: Marshall McLuhan

quote: If you really believe that you're making a difference and that you can leave a legacy of better schools and jobs and safer streets, why would you not spend the money? The objective is to improve the schools, bring down crime, build affordable housing, clean the streets - not to have a fair fight.
author: Michael Bloomberg

quote: My dad would give me $10, which is a lot of money when you're 9, to sing at church, on tables at restaurants, at family functions, just about anywhere.
author: Katy Perry

quote: Hollywood is so fake and people need to realize that people are just people, and you, too, don't need to be born into something or have money or have whatever product someone is hawking on you.
author: Katy Perry

quote: I think that what went wrong with religion is the same thing that went wrong with politics. Is that it became too money based and too controlling. It's just a weakness that we human beings have for control - we want one thing and then we want more and then we want more.
author: Dave Davies

quote: What white man can say I never stole his land or a penny of his money? Yet they say that I am a thief.
author: Sitting Bull

quote: Drug prohibition has caused gang warfare and other violent crimes by raising the prices of drugs so much that vicious criminals enter the market to make astronomical profits, and addicts rob and steal to get money to pay the inflated prices for their drugs.
author: Michael Badnarik

quote: People spend time worrying about things they think they have to have and lose perception of what they do have. You can have all the money and material things you want. If you aren't here to enjoy them, what good do they do?
author: Eric Davis

quote: There is nothing inherently fair about equalizing incomes. If the government penalizes you for working harder than somebody else, that is unfair. If you save your money but retire with the same pension as a free-spending neighbor, that is also unfair.
author: Arthur C. Brooks

quote: I don't need the money, dear. I work for art.
author: Maria Callas

quote: Bankers know that history is inflationary and that money is the last thing a wise man will hoard.
author: Will Durant

quote: It's a sad fact about our culture that a poet can earn much more money writing or talking about his art than he can by practicing it.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: The class distinctions proper to a democratic society are not those of rank or money, still less, as is apt to happen when these are abandoned, of race, but of age.
author: W. H. Auden

quote: The only way not to think about money is to have a great deal of it.
author: Edith Wharton

quote: I wanted to make a living, but I really was not interested in money at all. I was interested in being a great comedian.
author: Larry David

quote: I still think of that guy I was without a wife or kids, and I still want to entertain that guy. The lonely guy, the frustrated guy, the guy with no money - this is the guy who needs to laugh.
author: Larry David

quote: The extravagant expenditure of public money is an evil not to be measured by the value of that money to the people who are taxed for it.
author: Chester A. Arthur

quote: I think that lawyers are terrible at admitting that they're wrong. And not just admitting it also realizing it. Most lawyers are very successful, and they think that because they're making money and people think well of them, they must be doing everything right.
author: Alan Dershowitz

quote: You got to have a courageous president to stand up and says, listen, if - if you send a bill to me that spends more money than what we've coming in, I'll veto it. I mean, I'm going to try to work with you the best I can, but I'm going to veto it.
author: Rick Perry

quote: If you wake up deciding what you want to give versus what you're going to get, you become a more successful person. In other words, if you want to make money, you have to help someone else make money.
author: Russell Simmons

quote: To get rich, you have to be making money while you're asleep.
author: David Bailey

quote: I would like to see more airplay for all artists, no matter what age. I think there's a lot of money being spent toward the young guys, but a lot of the older guys are the ones who blazed the trail for those young guys.
author: Willie Nelson

quote: Making money is not gonna change anything about what I am, except I won't answer the door.
author: Abel Ferrara

quote: I think that money spoils most things, once it becomes the primary motivating force.
author: John Cleese

quote: I don't care half so much about making money as I do about making my point, and coming out ahead.
author: Cornelius Vanderbilt

quote: Often people attempt to live their lives backwards they try to have more things, or more money, in order to do more of what they want, so they will be happier.
author: Margaret Young

quote: The less money you owe, the less income you'll need and the less you'll have to save for tomorrow.
author: Suze Orman

quote: When I saw all those other drivers, I realized that they wanted to win that money just as much as I did. But I didn't have to worry. A tire came off my car and I was lucky I got it off the track.
author: Buck Baker

quote: Who would you want to be giving you advice? Somebody who doesn't have any money?
author: Suze Orman

quote: The foundation of a financial fresh start actually has nothing to do with money or specific financial dos and don'ts.
author: Suze Orman

quote: The first requisite of a sound monetary system is that it put the least possible power over the quantity or quality of money in the hands of the politicians.
author: Henry Hazlitt

quote: There is something fundamentally unfair about a government that takes away so much of people's money, power, and personal control while telling them that life will be better as a result.
author: Steve Forbes

quote: Nobody climbs mountains for scientific reasons. Science is used to raise money for the expeditions, but you really climb for the hell of it.
author: Edmund Hillary

quote: When I sent those scripts, that was the lowest point of my life. We'd just had our second son, and when I went to collect them from hospital, I went to the bank to try and get some money to buy some diapers, the screen showed I've got $26 left.
author: Ang Lee

quote: I don't like begging money from producers.
author: David Byrne

quote: Expensive clothes are a waste of money.
author: Meryl Streep

quote: Hussein has chosen to spend his money on building weapons of mass destruction and palaces for his cronies.
author: Madeleine Albright

quote: Geez, all that money we waste on space exploration just think how many bombs that would buy!
author: Craig Bruce

quote: I think when money starts to corrupt journalism, it undermines the journalism, and it undermines the credibility of the product, and you end up not succeeding.
author: Walter Isaacson

quote: What's my motto when it comes to money? Don't put so much emphasis on it!
author: Janice Dickinson

quote: As I have traveled throughout my Congressional district, the one thing I heard loud and clear was simply please stop spending money you do not have, rein in spending, live within a budget.
author: Tim Scott

quote: The biases the media has are much bigger than conservative or liberal. They're about getting ratings, about making money, about doing stories that are easy to cover.
author: Al Franken

quote: Money, if it does not bring you happiness, will at least help you be miserable in comfort.
author: Helen Gurley Brown

quote: Money is not a motivating factor. Money doesn't thrill me or make me play better because there are benefits to being wealthy. I'm just happy with a ball at my feet. My motivation comes from playing the game I love. If I wasn't paid to be a professional footballer I would willingly play for nothing.
author: Lionel Messi

quote: President Obama has outsourced a major portion of the U.S. space program to the Russians. That's national policy. Taxpayer money. So let's stop playing games with this outsourcing distortion and talk about the fact that when we need is a president that knows how to manage big enterprise and create jobs.
author: John Sununu

quote: Money isn't a major motivating force in my life. Nor is my profession. There are other things that I care more about than being an actor.
author: Kevin Costner

quote: Ridiculous yachts and private planes and big limousines won't make people enjoy life more, and it sends out terrible messages to the people who work for them. It would be so much better if that money was spent in Africa - and it's about getting a balance.
author: Richard Branson

quote: From paying off friends' tax bills to rescuing stray dogs and stuffing &pound20 notes into the hands of homeless people, I can't get rid of my money fast enough.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: Billions are wasted on ineffective philanthropy. Philanthropy is decades behind business in applying rigorous thinking to the use of money.
author: Michael Porter

quote: As a child, I wanted only two things - to be left alone to read my library books, and to get away from my provincial hometown and go to London to be a writer. And I always knew that when I got there, I wanted to make loads of money.
author: Julie Burchill

quote: They say Yogi Berra is funny. Well, he has a lovely wife and family, a beautiful home, money in the bank, and he plays golf with millionaires. What's funny about that?
author: Casey Stengel

quote: We are used to female writers who use their private lives as unmitigated material being somewhat hormonal this somehow 'excuses' what might be seen as a highly unfeminine ability to turn their personal upsets into money.
author: Julie Burchill
